useAdviceForDataSet.value:
Scope: 
This EPD specifies the environmental impacts of 1 unit of Hollow Metal Medallion Door with Steel Stiffened Core with packaging.

This declaration is relevant to the product manufactured in France Metal's Factory at 10th of Ramadan, Egypt. 
System boundary: 
The following Life Cycle Stages were considered:

Production (A1-A3): Extraction and manufacturing of all supply materials (steel sheets, glue, rubber, paint etc.) used in manufacturing the product. Transportation of these raw materials and energy consumption from electricity and light fuel oil within the manufacturing plant are considered in the scope of this module. 

A4 – Transport to installation site: Average distance of 1000 km considered for the transport from the manufacturing plant to various construction sites.

A5 – Installation: Packaging waste processing. 

End-of-life: 

C1 – Dismantling/Demolition: No impact as the dismantling could be manual.

C2 – Transport to treatment/disposal site: Average transport distance of 50 km from the demolition site to waste treatment (recycling) site.

C3 – Waste processing (recycling): No impacts from waste processing for recycling.

C4 – Disposal: Landfill of part of steel and other product components. 

Benefits and loads beyond the product system boundary (D): The potential benefits from packaging material are declared. For waste incineration combustion in a waste incineration plant (R1 > 0.6) with energy recuperation is considered. The benefits and loads from steel recycling are considered under module D.
